shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, fly-out, toasts. Panels never get shadow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one blue action per area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:36px; padding:0 14px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:#7C3AED; color:#fff; font:500 13px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#6D28D9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #7C3AED; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:36px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid #E9E7EF; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:#4A4658; font:500 13px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#FAF9FC; border-color:#D5D2DE; color:#1A1726; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 36px field with a blue focus ring; red when invalid.
components.css: .ds-input { height:36px; width:260px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #E9E7EF; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:#1A1726; font:400 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#6B6880; } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#7C3AED; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(124,58,237,0.14); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Filters with 2–6 options: status, period, call type.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; padding:3px; background:#F1F0F5; border-radius:9px; } .ds-seg button { height:28px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:#6B6880; font:500 12.5px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#fff; color:#1A1726; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(26,23,38,0.08); } .ds-seg button:hover { color:#1A1726; }

components.name: Call Type Badge
components.description: Fixed colour per call type, everywhere.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; height:22px; padding:0 8px; border-radius:6px; font:500 12px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge i { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:99px; background:currentColor; } .ds-out { color:#7C3AED; background:#F5F3FF; } .ds-miss { color:#D92D20; background:#FEF3F2; }

components.name: Scorebar
components.description: Signature: one panel of scores divided by seams; colour only for met/behind.
components.html:
Calls today

1,284 / 1,60080% of target

Current rate

142/hr16/hr short of required
components.css: .ds-score { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); background:#fff; border:1px solid #E9E7EF; border-radius:12px; font-family:Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-score > div { padding:16px 20px; } .ds-score > div + div { border-left:1px solid #F1F0F5; } .ds-score p { margin:0; font-size:12.5px; color:#6B6880; } .ds-score b { display:block; margin-top:4px; font-size:26px; line-height:32px; font-weight:600; color:#1A1726; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-score b.behind { color:#D92D20; } .ds-score small { font-size:15px; font-weight:500; color:#6B6880; margin-left:4px; } .ds-score span { font-size:12px; color:#6B6880; }

narrative.overview: A tele-calling floor's day is an innings: calls done, the target, how many are still needed, and whether the current rate will get there. The interface reads every count against its target. It is calm, dense and familiar — white panels, hairline seams, one blue ink — with colour spent only where it means something.
keyCharacteristics: Pace-first dashboard: scorebar, worm chart vs dashed target, behind-the-rate list
One blue accent; red only for behind, green only for met
Inter with tabular figures; sentence case; en-IN digit grouping
Every page has one nav home; nothing labelled twice

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only decorative-weight colour; every other hue must name what it means.

rules.name: Against Its Target
rules.body: Show a number against its target or comparison whenever one exists.

rules.name: Seams, Not Shadows
rules.body: Panels separate by 1px seams; shadow is only for floating layers.

dos: Do show numbers against their target
Do keep IST hours as the API returns them
Do animate transform/opacity with the strong ease-out at 140–260ms
donts: Don't add icon tiles or gradients to scores
Don't put a kicker or breadcrumb above a page title
Don't show the same data twice on a screen
Don't use purple, indigo, transition: all, or ease-in
